name: Cold Quench
story: The apprentice holds a finished blade over the oil. The quench room has been locked since the last order.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The arsenal is cold. Ila holds a finished blade over the oil and does not lower it.

beforeStory.speaker: Ila
beforeStory.text: They will not move for me. The smith will not leave this room until the edge is right.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The blade goes into the oil. Ila keeps her hand on the tang until the steam clears.

afterStory.speaker: Ila
afterStory.text: Not finished. It still has to be carried to the wall before dark.

name: The Test Cut
story: The practice hall is full of straw soldiers and orders nobody carried out.

beforeStory.speaker: Ila
beforeStory.text: Cut the beam. Not the post, not me. The beam.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Two men still run the drill. They have not been told the war is over.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The cut holds. Ila marks the beam with chalk and steps back to look at it.

afterStory.speaker: Ila
afterStory.text: It will do. It only has to be worth carrying.

name: Delivery at Dusk
story: The sword is for a house that stopped answering its door years ago.

beforeStory.speaker: Ila
beforeStory.text: I carry it. If you walk beside me, they will not open the door.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Mara waits at the corner with the waterskin. Arith goes on alone.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The door opens. Ila sets the sword on the table inside and comes back out without it.

afterStory.speaker: Ila
afterStory.text: It is delivered. I do not have anywhere to be now. May I walk with you?

chapter: Chapter I - Names on the Wall
name: Names on the Wall
story: A mason carves the names of soldiers who never came back, one letter at a time.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: A mason works along the wall. The list is long and he is still at the beginning of it.

beforeStory.speaker: Mason
beforeStory.text: Do not stand where I am cutting. The names go here, not around you.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The mason finishes a name and starts the next. He does not ask Arith to add one.

chapter: Chapter I - Names on the Wall
name: The Watch Relieved
story: The relief never came. The watch still stands where it was posted.

beforeStory.speaker: Standing Watch
beforeStory.text: I am not tired. I am waiting for the one who takes the post.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith takes the post until morning. Nobody comes, and the wall is colder than the road.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: At dawn Arith steps down. The watch stays where it has always stood, but it faces the road now.
